composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_ceres:
Care in this relationship comes with teeth.

Ceres is the daily tending, the feeding and the fear of loss. Lilith is the part that will not be owned. Together they produce a fierce protectiveness, like an animal guarding its young, along with an equally fierce resistance to being mothered. The two of you look after each other intensely and on your own terms. Trouble comes when care turns into a claim. Help offered here has to be free to be refused.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_ceres:
This relationship can look after its rawer needs if it chooses to notice them.

Lilith holds the hungers that are hard to admit, and Ceres is practical nurture. The sextile lets one answer the other. A meal, rest, or simple physical comfort can settle what would otherwise turn into a quarrel, and honesty about need makes the care more accurate. It works when someone speaks up. Unvoiced, the need goes unfed and the care goes to the wrong place.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_ceres:
The wish to be looked after and the refusal to depend collide here.

Ceres gives and holds on. Lilith pulls free. In a square, tending feels like control to the one receiving it, and independence feels like rejection to the one giving it. Arguments attach themselves to food, health, money and who does more. Separation is a sore subject. It helps to ask before helping, and to hear a refusal as a statement about freedom and nothing worse.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_ceres:
Fierce independence and steady care sit side by side without trouble.

The two of you can nurture each other without anyone feeling smothered, and can go your own ways without anyone feeling abandoned. Lilith keeps the care honest and Ceres keeps the wildness fed. Partings and reunions are taken in stride. The comfortable arrangement can hide a reluctance to need each other very much, so it is worth checking that self-reliance has not quietly replaced closeness.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_ceres:
One partner tends and the other will not be tended.

Ceres and Lilith face each other, so the giver of care and the refuser of it become two people. The carer feels unappreciated and the independent one feels crowded. Each privately wants a little of what the other has: the carer some freedom, the free one some looking-after. Saying so changes the pattern more than any amount of effort in the usual roles.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_eris:
This relationship is built to disturb the peace.

Eris speaks for whoever was left off the guest list, and Lilith for whoever refused to obey. Joined, they give the partnership a sharp eye for hypocrisy and no inclination to keep quiet about it. The two of you may be a force for honesty in any group you enter. You may also be a source of constant friction, picking at each other when no outside target presents itself. A cause worth the trouble is the best use of it.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_eris:
The nerve to call out what is false is here when the occasion deserves it.

Lilith's refusal and Eris's truth-telling work together on request. When something unfair needs naming, in the relationship or around it, the two of you can do it cleanly and stand the discomfort. Between such occasions the edge stays sheathed. That restraint is part of the advantage, since a challenge made rarely carries more weight.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_eris:
Two kinds of defiance rub each other raw.

Lilith will not submit and Eris will not be excluded. Squared, the pair can provoke for the sake of provoking, each stung by a slight the other did not intend. Feelings of being the outsider, even inside the relationship, are common. So are arguments over fairness that neither can drop. The energy is wasted on each other. Directed outward, at something that merits a fight, it is considerable.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_eris:
Dissent comes naturally to this relationship and rarely costs it much.

The two of you say unpopular things with ease and back each other when the room turns cold. Lilith supplies the independence and Eris the insistence on being heard. Being outsiders together feels like home. That comfort can turn into a pose. A pair that always expects to stand apart may stop noticing when it is welcome, and miss the chance to belong.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_eris:
One of you walks away from the table and the other overturns it.

Lilith's response to a wrong is to leave and owe nothing. Eris's response is to stay and make trouble. Opposed, these become two partners with two strategies, each impatient with the other's. One seems cold and the other seems to enjoy the fight. Both are answers to exclusion. Agreeing on which wrongs deserve which response saves the pair from fighting about how to fight.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_eros:
Desire in this relationship is strong, unvarnished and hard to stand back from.

Eros is attraction as a force that pulls two people together. Lilith is appetite with no manners. Joined, they make the physical and emotional pull between you intense and a little consuming. It can be the centre the whole partnership turns on. Jealousy and fixation come with it, and a habit of settling disputes in bed. The bond needs other foundations as well, so that it is not asked to carry everything.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_eros:
Frankness about desire is an easy step for this relationship to take.

Lilith holds what each of you actually wants, and Eros the attraction between you. The sextile makes it simple to say the one in service of the other. A direct word about preference or fantasy tends to be welcomed and to deepen the chemistry. It still has to be said. Left to hints, the attraction stays pleasant and never reaches its full strength.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_eros:
Wanting and refusing are tangled together here.

Eros draws the two of you close and Lilith insists on staying free. Squared, desire is charged with a fear of being possessed or turned away, and attraction can be used as a weapon. Pursuit and withdrawal alternate. Jealousy runs high. The intensity is real, but it feeds on uncertainty. A plain statement of wanting, made without a test attached, does more for the bond than any amount of drama.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_eros:
Attraction here is uncomplicated by shame.

Lilith's instinct and Eros's pull move together. The two of you are at ease with each other's bodies and appetites, and desire renews itself without much effort. It is a real asset to the partnership. It can also become the easy answer to every difficulty, so that things which need talking through are simply smoothed over by closeness.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_eros:
One of you reaches and the other holds apart.

Eros longs to merge and Lilith will not be merged. Set opposite each other, they make one partner the lover in pursuit and the other the one who cannot be had entirely. The distance keeps the desire alive, and both of you may half know it. It grows painful if the roles never change. Each needs a turn at wanting openly and a turn at being wanted.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_hygiea:
This relationship treats health as a matter of instinct and honesty.

Hygiea is care of the body and the clearing out of what does harm. Lilith is the animal knowledge that predates advice. Together they incline the two of you to trust what your bodies tell you and to purge anything, substance or situation, that feels wrong. It makes for a clean, uncompromising way of living. Taken to an extreme it becomes harsh, with the body treated as something to be purified at all costs.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_hygiea:
The body's blunt signals can guide this relationship toward better habits.

Lilith notices what the two of you really crave or cannot stomach, and Hygiea turns that into sensible care. The sextile joins them when attention is paid. Listening to tiredness, appetite and unease, then adjusting, keeps the pair well. Nothing forces this. The signals are easy to override, and the link is only as useful as the habit of heeding it.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_hygiea:
What this relationship craves and what is good for it disagree.

Hygiea wants order, moderation and clean routines. Lilith wants what she wants. Squared, good intentions about health are undone by appetite, or appetite is policed so strictly that it rebels. One of you may play the reformer and the other the offender. Shame makes it worse. A regime that leaves room for pleasure lasts longer than one built on denial.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_hygiea:
Instinct and wellbeing support each other in this relationship.

The two of you tend to know what you need and to give it without fuss, and the body is treated as an ally. Lilith keeps the care from turning prim and Hygiea keeps the appetite from turning destructive. It is a healthy arrangement in the plain sense. The only caution is against assuming it will look after itself through periods of strain, when instinct is less reliable.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_hygiea:
One of you cleans up and the other makes the mess.

Hygiea's concern for order and health faces Lilith's disregard for both. One partner becomes the one who worries about diet, sleep and symptoms, and the other the one who will not be managed. Each exaggerates in response to the other. The worry is usually partly fear and the defiance partly fear as well. Naming what each is afraid of brings the two closer to the middle.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_juno:
Commitment in this relationship has to leave the wild part free.

Juno is the bond as a contract between equals. Lilith is the one who walked out sooner than accept unequal terms. Together they make a partnership that takes its promises seriously and will not tolerate being diminished by them. Equality is not optional here. Any hint of ownership or double standard is met with fury. The terms must be ones both of you would sign again each year.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_juno:
A fairer agreement is within reach whenever this relationship asks for it.

Lilith knows where each of you feels short-changed, and Juno is the commitment itself. The sextile lets that knowledge improve the terms. Raising a grievance about fairness tends to lead to an adjustment, and not a row. The link has to be used. Resentments left unspoken gain nothing from it.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_juno:
The promise and the refusal to be bound strain against each other.

Juno asks for loyalty and shared burdens. Lilith asks who is getting the worse bargain. Squared, commitment can feel like submission to one of you and freedom like betrayal to the other. Disputes over who gives more, and threats to leave, are the usual forms. Jealousy sharpens it. The bond survives by being renegotiated honestly, including the parts nobody wanted to reopen.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_juno:
Loyalty and independence coexist comfortably here.

The two of you can be committed without feeling caged, and free without being faithless. Lilith keeps the contract honest and Juno gives the independence somewhere to return to. Each trusts the other to stay by choice. It is a strong basis for a long partnership. The risk is leaving the terms unexamined because nothing has gone wrong yet.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_juno:
One of you keeps the vow and the other tests it.

Juno stands for the committed partner and Lilith for the one who will not be held. Across the relationship, one of you tends to embody steadiness and the other the threat of departure. The steady one feels taken for granted and the restless one feels judged. Underneath, both want a bond between equals. It comes when the loyal one claims some freedom and the free one makes a promise unprompted.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_nessus:
This relationship meets the darkest inherited patterns head on.

Nessus marks where harm is passed down and where it can finally be stopped. Lilith is raw instinct and the refusal to be used. Joined, they bring old injuries involving power, sex and betrayal to the surface with great force. The two of you may recognise each other's damage at once. That can lead to repeating it together or to ending it. Which one depends on naming what is happening while it happens.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_nessus:
The strength to stop a harmful pattern is available here.

Nessus shows the pair where an old wrong keeps repeating, and Lilith supplies the refusal. Through the sextile, the two of you can say that it ends with you, and mean it. It takes a conscious decision at the moment the pattern starts. Made often enough, that decision becomes a habit and the pattern loses its grip.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_nessus:
Old harm and raw defiance aggravate each other.

Nessus carries the cycle of injury and revenge. Lilith carries the fury of the one wronged. Squared, each of you can cast the other as the offender from some earlier story and react accordingly. Accusation, retaliation and a sense of being used go round and round. This pairing benefits from outside help more than most. The cycle is older than the relationship and is not settled by winning an argument.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_nessus:
This relationship can look at abuse and its aftermath without being overwhelmed.

Lilith's clear refusal and Nessus's knowledge of how harm works support each other. The two of you can discuss painful histories plainly and tend to recognise manipulation quickly, in yourselves and in others. It makes the partnership a safe place for hard truths. The danger lies in growing so used to dark material that it stops seeming urgent to change anything.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_nessus:
One of you carries the wound and the other the rage about it.

Nessus and Lilith face each other, and the story of harm gets divided. One partner appears as the injured party, the other as the one who refuses to be a victim, and each may be impatient with the other's stance. Sometimes one is cast as the wrongdoer outright. The division is false. Both hurt and anger belong to both of you, and the pattern weakens once that is admitted.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_pallas:
This relationship thinks strategically about how to stay free.

Pallas is cool intelligence, pattern and fair judgment. Lilith is instinct that owes nothing to anyone. Together they make a pair that is shrewd in defence of its independence and quick to see through a manoeuvre. Injustice is spotted early and answered with a plan. The combination can be formidable. It can also be cold, with every feeling turned into a position to be argued.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_pallas:
Clear thinking can give this relationship's instincts a workable shape.

Lilith knows what the two of you will not put up with, and Pallas knows how to design around it. The sextile joins gut and strategy when both are consulted. A problem that provokes strong feeling can be solved here by stepping back and planning. It needs the stepping back. In the heat of the moment the link goes unused.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_pallas:
Reason and raw instinct talk past each other.

Pallas wants the fair, logical solution. Lilith wants the wrong acknowledged. Squared, one of you analyses while the other burns, and each finds the other's response infuriating. Being told to calm down is taken as an insult, and anger is dismissed as irrational. Both forms of intelligence are needed. The feeling should be heard first and the plan made second.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_pallas:
Instinct and judgment agree with each other here.

The two of you sense what is wrong and can also say why, which makes your objections hard to dismiss. Lilith's independence gives the thinking courage and Pallas gives the instinct precision. Together you are good advocates. The risk is over-reliance on being right. A pair so well armed can win arguments it would have been wiser not to have.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_pallas:
One of you argues the case and the other simply refuses.

Pallas reasons and Lilith reacts. Opposed, they become a strategist and a rebel. The strategist thinks the rebel reckless, and the rebel thinks the strategist bloodless. Each is strong where the other is weak. When they cooperate, the relationship both knows what it will not accept and knows how to say so effectively.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_fortune:
This relationship is luckiest when it follows its own nature.

The Part of Fortune shows where ease and material wellbeing come from. Lilith on it ties them to the pair's independence. Good things tend to arrive when the two of you ignore advice, trust your appetites and decline to fit in. Conformity seems to shut the tap. That is a pleasant fate, and it can breed arrogance about never needing to compromise.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_fortune:
A little boldness tends to bring this relationship good luck.

Lilith is the pair's unedited instinct and the Part of Fortune its natural ease. The sextile means that acting on instinct, now and then, opens a door. An honest refusal or an unconventional choice often turns out well in practical terms. It works by invitation. The cautious course loses nothing, but gains nothing either.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_fortune:
Comfort and wildness interfere with each other here.

The Part of Fortune offers ease, pleasure and material luck. Lilith distrusts anything that might tame her. Squared, the two of you may sabotage a good thing because it felt like settling, or buy comfort at the cost of something essential and resent it. Money and enjoyment become charged subjects. The task is to accept good fortune without feeling bought.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_fortune:
Being true to instinct and doing well go together in this relationship.

The two of you seldom have to choose between comfort and freedom. Lilith's independence and the Part of Fortune's ease support each other, so that pleasure is taken without guilt and luck seems to favour your more unconventional choices. It is an enviable position. The only thing asked is not to mistake it for proof that the rules never apply.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_fortune:
One of you holds the ease and the other the hunger.

The Part of Fortune and Lilith face each other. One partner appears content, lucky and at home in the world, while the other stays unsatisfied and unwilling to settle. Envy can creep in on one side and impatience on the other. Each has something the other needs. Contentment gains depth from the hunger, and the hunger finds some rest in the contentment.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_spirit:
What this relationship sets out to do is driven by what it refuses to be.

The Part of Spirit is conscious purpose and chosen direction. Lilith on it makes that purpose a defiant one. The two of you are likely to aim at something that breaks with expectation, and to pursue it with conviction. The energy is considerable. The question to keep asking is whether the aim is for something, or only against, since rebellion alone runs out.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_spirit:
The pair's raw instincts can sharpen its sense of direction.

Lilith knows what the two of you will not accept, and the Part of Spirit is what you intend to make of your time together. With a sextile, consulting the first clarifies the second. Plans improve when they take account of what you actually want. The link is quiet and easily skipped, which is a pity when a decision is being made.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_spirit:
The plan and the instinct pull apart.

The Part of Spirit lays out what the relationship means to accomplish. Lilith does not take direction. Squared, good intentions are upset by urges that were left out of the plan, and the two of you may feel that some part of you is always spoiling the project. It is worth hearing that part out. An aim that keeps being undermined from within is usually too narrow.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_spirit:
Purpose and instinct move in step here.

What the two of you choose to do and what you feel like doing seldom conflict. Lilith lends conviction to the pair's aims and the Part of Spirit gives the instinct somewhere to go. Projects started together have unusual energy. The agreement between will and appetite is so smooth that it can pass unexamined, and it is still worth asking, sometimes, whether the direction is a good one.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_spirit:
One of you sets the course and the other will not follow it.

The Part of Spirit stands for deliberate intention and Lilith for the instinct that goes its own way. Between partners this becomes a planner and a resister. The planner feels thwarted and the resister feels steered. Often the resistance is pointing at something the plan ignored. The course improves when both of you draw it.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_pholus:
Small things set off large reactions in this relationship.

Pholus is the lid that comes off: a minor cause with consequences out of all proportion. Lilith is raw and unguarded instinct. Joined, they make the pair volatile in a particular way. One remark or one drink or one disclosure can release something that takes weeks to settle. What comes out is usually old and true. It helps to know this about yourselves and choose your moments.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_pholus:
This relationship can open a difficult subject on purpose and survive it.

Pholus releases what has been sealed, and Lilith is not afraid of what is inside. The sextile lets the two of you lift the lid deliberately, a little at a time. A hard truth told at a chosen moment can clear years of pressure. The timing is yours to pick, which is the whole advantage over having it burst out unasked.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_pholus:
Outbursts here tend to run away with themselves.

Lilith reacts and Pholus multiplies. In a square, a flash of temper or a careless revelation can set off a chain of consequences neither of you intended. Afterwards it is hard to say how it grew so large. Family history often supplies the fuel. A pause before reacting matters more in this partnership than in most, because the first move is so hard to take back.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_pholus:
Release comes easily in this relationship, and mostly does good.

The two of you let things out before they fester. Lilith's honesty and Pholus's gift for sudden change work together, so that secrets surface and tension clears without much damage. Big shifts are taken calmly. The ease can make you casual about uncorking things that other people, or quieter parts of yourselves, were not ready for.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_pholus:
One of you lights the fuse and the other is the charge.

Pholus sets things off and Lilith is what goes off. Opposed, the two roles land on different partners, and each blames the other for the explosion. The one who made the small remark did not mean all that, and the one who reacted cannot see why it was said. Looking together at what was released, and how long it had been waiting, is more use than arguing over who began it.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_south_node:
Defiance is an old and familiar habit in this relationship.

The South Node shows what a partnership falls back on. Lilith there makes the default a fierce self-protection: walking out, refusing, trusting no one. The two of you may have brought it from earlier lives or earlier loves. It comes without thinking and once served well. Now it tends to repeat without getting anywhere. Growth lies in the opposite direction, toward whatever the reflex was guarding against.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_south_node:
The pair's past gives it a fund of independence to draw on.

Lilith's self-possession links easily to the South Node's store of old experience. When the two of you need to stand your ground, you already know how. The knowledge is useful in small amounts. The same link sits just as easily with the future, so the skill can serve where the relationship is going and need not keep it where it has been.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_south_node:
Raw instinct fits neither the old pattern nor the new direction.

Lilith squares the whole nodal axis here. The familiar way of doing things has no place for her, and the path of growth has not made one yet. The two of you may feel that your most honest impulses belong nowhere in the story of the relationship. Fitting them in is part of the work. A future that makes room for them will be easier to reach.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_south_node:
Independence is something this relationship has always known how to do.

Lilith and the South Node agree. The two of you slip readily into self-reliance and into a shared understanding that neither will be owned. It feels natural and asks nothing of you. For that reason it can become a resting place. What is easy here has been learned already, and the relationship's new learning is somewhere less comfortable.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_south_node:
The untamed side of this relationship points toward its future.

Opposite the South Node, Lilith stands with the North Node, the direction of growth. Old habits here are likely to be compliant and accommodating ones. What the two of you are asked to develop is the nerve to say no, to want openly and to stop keeping the peace at your own expense. It feels unfamiliar and a little dangerous. It is also where the life of the partnership lies.
composite_aspect.lilith_conjunction_vesta:
Devotion in this relationship is fierce and answers to no one.

Vesta is the flame that is tended: focus, dedication, what is held sacred. Lilith is the one who will not be ruled. Joined, they make a pair that guards its central commitment with intensity and keeps it private. Sexuality may be treated as something sacred, or be set aside for the sake of the work. Either way, the two of you decide what is holy here, and outside opinion counts for little.
composite_aspect.lilith_sextile_vesta:
Focus and instinct can serve each other when this relationship asks them to.

Vesta is concentrated dedication and Lilith is raw energy. Through the sextile, the energy can be gathered and put behind one thing, and the dedication can be kept alive by honest desire. A shared practice or project benefits from both. Setting it up takes intent. Without that, the focus and the fire go their separate ways.
composite_aspect.lilith_square_vesta:
Appetite and devotion will not leave each other alone.

Vesta asks for purity of focus and Lilith will not be made pure. Squared, the two of you may swing between strict dedication and breaking out of it, or one may withdraw into work while the other feels shut out and angry. Guilt about pleasure and resentment of duty are both likely. A commitment that allows for the body and its wants is the one that holds.
composite_aspect.lilith_trine_vesta:
What this relationship desires and what it holds sacred are in agreement.

Lilith's instinct feeds Vesta's flame. The two of you can give yourselves wholly to something, a calling or each other, without feeling that any part has been denied. Intensity and discipline cooperate. This is a rare harmony. Its one hazard is exclusiveness, a devotion so complete and self-sufficient that nobody else is let near.
composite_aspect.lilith_opposition_vesta:
One of you tends the flame and the other runs wild.

Vesta's quiet dedication faces Lilith's freedom. Between partners that means one who is focused, contained and perhaps withdrawn, and one who is restless and will not be confined. The devoted one seems cold and the free one seems careless. Each could use the other's quality. Dedication warms when it admits desire, and wildness steadies when it finds something to serve.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_eris:
This relationship feeds the people nobody else invited.

Eris stands with the excluded and says so loudly. Ceres provides. Joined, they make the two of you protective of outsiders and quick to notice who has been left without a share. Care has a political edge here. Meals and households become places where fairness is argued out. The combination can also turn nurturing into a quarrel, with help given pointedly, as a rebuke to someone else.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_eris:
Standing up for someone is one of the ways this relationship can care.

Ceres looks after and Eris speaks out. The sextile lets them cooperate when a situation calls for it. If one of you, or someone close, is being overlooked or treated unfairly, the pair can provide support and say what needs saying. It is an occasional tool more than a daily habit, and all the more effective for being used sparingly.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_eris:
Care and conflict keep getting mixed up.

Ceres wants everyone fed and settled. Eris wants the unfairness named first. Squared, family meals, shared resources and questions of who looks after whom become occasions for dispute. One of you may feel left out of the care, and say so sharply. The grievance is usually genuine and badly timed. Hearing it outside the kitchen, so to speak, lets both the care and the complaint be dealt with properly.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_eris:
This relationship looks after the left-out as a matter of course.

Nurture and plain speaking go together without strain. The two of you make room for the awkward guest and the difficult relative, and can raise a matter of fairness without spoiling the meal. Others feel that honesty is safe in your house. The one thing to check is that the pair's sympathy for outsiders does not leave its own members last in the queue.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_eris:
One of you keeps the peace at home and the other disturbs it.

Ceres holds the household together and Eris asks who was not consulted. Opposed, one partner becomes the provider of comfort and the other the voice of complaint. The provider finds the other ungrateful, and the complainer finds the comfort a way of smoothing over wrongs. There is truth on both sides. Comfort that can hear a complaint is worth more, and a complaint made with some care is more likely to be heard.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_eros:
Desire and tenderness are closely joined in this relationship.

Eros is passionate attraction and Ceres is care for the body. Together they make physical love nurturing and nurture sensual. The two of you may express desire through feeding, bathing and tending each other, and feel most wanted when most looked after. It is a warm and earthy bond. The line between lover and parent can blur, which sometimes cools the very passion it began with.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_eros:
Looking after each other's bodies can kindle attraction here.

Ceres tends and Eros desires. The sextile links them by invitation. Care given with attention, a meal prepared, a tired back rubbed, readily turns toward intimacy when both wish it. It is a simple way of keeping warmth alive. It has to be offered as care first, and allowed to become more only if it does.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_eros:
Being mothered and being wanted get in each other's way.

Eros wants a lover and Ceres offers a caretaker. Squared, the two of you can fall into roles that kill desire: one tending, the other tended. Or passion may be pursued at the expense of ordinary kindness. Food and sex can both become ways of managing each other. It helps to notice which is being asked for at a given moment, comfort or desire, and answer that one.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_eros:
Passion and care feed each other in this relationship.

The two of you move easily between looking after one another and wanting one another, and neither spoils the other. Ceres makes desire feel safe and Eros keeps care from becoming routine. Physical life is affectionate and sustaining. The comfort is real. It can make the pair a little self-enclosed, content with each other's company to the point of needing no one else.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_eros:
One of you offers care and the other offers desire.

Ceres and Eros face each other, and their gifts get divided. One partner shows love by providing and the other by wanting. Each may feel the other is missing the point. The provider longs to be desired and the lover longs to be looked after, though neither says it. Asking for what you usually give is the quickest way to change the pattern.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_hygiea:
Health is how this relationship shows that it cares.

Ceres feeds and Hygiea keeps the body well. Together they focus the pair on diet, rest, cleanliness and prevention. The two of you look after each other's wellbeing attentively, and a well-kept, wholesome household matters to you. It is a sound basis for a long life together. It can become anxious. Concern for health turns into monitoring, and food into a matter of rules.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_hygiea:
Good habits are easy for this relationship to adopt once it decides to.

Ceres provides nourishment and Hygiea knows what is wholesome. With a sextile, the two of you can improve how you eat, sleep and recover without much struggle, each encouraging the other. The gain is practical and steady. It depends on a decision, and on someone going first.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_hygiea:
Comfort and discipline disagree about what is good for you.

Ceres says eat, rest, be comforted. Hygiea says moderate, cleanse, take care. Squared, the two of you may quarrel over food and health, with one indulging and the other correcting. Care feels like criticism. Illness or diet can become a point of control. What helps is agreeing on a few shared habits and leaving each other's plates alone otherwise.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_hygiea:
This relationship keeps itself well without making a project of it.

Nourishment and good sense work together. The two of you tend to eat properly, rest when tired and notice early when something is amiss, and you do it for each other without nagging. The household is healthy in an unforced way. That is worth valuing. It needs only a little vigilance in hard times, when the routine slips first.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_hygiea:
One of you comforts and the other corrects.

Ceres offers the second helping and Hygiea counts it. Opposed, one partner becomes the indulgent provider and the other the guardian of health. Each undermines the other and feels undermined. The comforter is called careless and the guardian is called joyless. A household needs both pleasure and prudence, and it is better when each of you supplies some of each.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_juno:
Commitment in this relationship means looking after each other.

Juno is the partnership as a lasting agreement and Ceres is daily provision. Joined, they make care part of the vow. The two of you understand loyalty as showing up: feeding, nursing, sharing the load. It gives the bond great practical solidity. The risk is that the marriage becomes a household and little else, with partners turning into co-parents or co-managers.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_juno:
Acts of care can reinforce this relationship's commitment.

Ceres tends and Juno binds. The sextile lets one strengthen the other when the two of you make the effort. Looking after each other in concrete ways, especially when it is inconvenient, makes the promise feel real. It is a quiet resource. Neglected, the commitment stays a matter of words.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_juno:
Who looks after whom is a point of contention in this partnership.

Juno wants an agreement between equals. Ceres gives as a parent gives, without counting. Squared, the two of you may disagree about how much care is owed and whether it is fairly shared. One feels like the household's servant, or like a child being managed. Children or dependants can come between you. The terms of care need stating as plainly as any other part of the bargain.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_juno:
Loyalty and care strengthen each other here.

The two of you keep faith by looking after one another, and it comes naturally. Ceres gives the commitment warmth and Juno gives the care a frame that lasts. Burdens are shared without much bookkeeping. This is the stuff of durable partnerships. It is only necessary to keep some part of the bond that is not about duty at all.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_juno:
One of you is the parent and the other the partner.

Ceres and Juno face each other, and the relationship is pulled between nurturing and equal alliance. One of you may be more absorbed in caring, for children, family or the other's needs, while the other wants a spouse and a peer. Each feels neglected in a different way. The balance returns when time is made for the two of you as a couple, apart from everyone you look after.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_nessus:
Care in this relationship touches old harm.

Nessus marks patterns of damage handed down, often around what should have been safe. Ceres is the parent and provider. Joined, they bring up histories of neglect, smothering or care that came with a price. The two of you may be determined to do better, and that determination is the best of this contact. The old pattern tends to reappear in subtle form, so it needs watching with honesty.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_nessus:
This relationship can use care to help end an old pattern.

Nessus shows where harm repeats, and Ceres offers steady, ordinary kindness. The sextile lets the second work on the first. Consistent looking-after, given freely, gradually corrects what earlier experience taught about care. It is slow and it works. The two of you have to keep choosing it, especially on the days when the old reflex is strong.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_nessus:
Nurture and old injury are painfully entangled.

Ceres reaches out to care and Nessus remembers care that hurt. Squared, kindness can be mistrusted, tested or turned into a means of control, and each of you may replay a role from the family you came from. Guilt and obligation do the damage. This is delicate ground, and it may need a third party. The aim is care with no hook in it.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_nessus:
This relationship can face the damage done in the name of care and still be kind.

Ceres and Nessus cooperate. The two of you are able to talk about family harm calmly and to recognise an unhealthy pattern of dependence when it starts. That awareness protects the tenderness between you. It is a strength. Complacency is the only real risk, the assumption that because the pattern is understood it cannot recur.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_nessus:
One of you cares and the other suspects the care.

Ceres offers and Nessus flinches. Opposed, one partner takes the role of giver while the other, for reasons older than the relationship, reads giving as a trap. The giver is hurt and the wary one feels cornered. Sometimes the giving does carry a hidden demand. Honesty from both, about motive on one side and fear on the other, is the way out.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_pallas:
This relationship looks after things intelligently.

Pallas is skill, strategy and clear judgment, and Ceres is care. Together they make nurture practical and well planned. The two of you are good at organising a household, managing someone's treatment, or teaching a child, and you take pride in doing it competently. Care is shown through problem-solving. It can leave feeling out of account, with a solution offered where sympathy was wanted.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_pallas:
A good plan can make this relationship's caring more effective.

Ceres wants to help and Pallas knows how to go about it. With a sextile, the two of you can think through a caring task together and do it well. Illness, schooling, a tight budget all yield to this. It requires sitting down and working it out. The feeling and the method are both present and need introducing to each other.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_pallas:
Heart and head disagree about how to help.

Ceres responds with comfort and Pallas with analysis. Squared, one of you tends while the other strategises, and each thinks the other is missing what matters. The carer seems sentimental and the planner seems cold. Disputes about raising children or handling a relative's needs are typical. Both are trying to help. Deciding first what the person actually needs, comfort or a plan, settles most of it.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_pallas:
Kindness and good sense work together in this relationship.

The two of you care wisely. Ceres supplies the warmth and Pallas the judgment, so help is both meant and well aimed. Practical difficulties are handled with calm competence, and those you look after are in good hands. It is a capable pairing. The only thing to guard is the assumption that you always know best what others need.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_pallas:
One of you tends and the other thinks it through.

Ceres acts from the heart and Pallas from the head. Opposed, they settle on different partners. One provides the meals and the comfort while the other provides the plan. Each can feel the other's contribution is the lesser. In fact a household run on one alone is either chaotic or chilly. The division works when both jobs are respected and sometimes exchanged.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_fortune:
This relationship prospers through what it nurtures.

The Part of Fortune marks where ease and material wellbeing come from. Ceres on it ties them to food, land, care and anything that grows by being tended. The two of you do well when you look after things patiently. There is usually enough on the table. The comfort is real and it rewards steadiness more than speed.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_fortune:
Tending things carefully tends to bring this relationship good fortune.

Ceres is the pair's capacity to sustain, and the Part of Fortune its natural luck. The sextile means that patient, practical care opens modest doors. A garden, a kitchen, a person looked after well, each has a way of returning something. The link is gentle. It rewards the effort when the effort is made.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_fortune:
Looking after others and enjoying good fortune compete here.

The Part of Fortune offers ease and pleasure. Ceres has duties. Squared, the two of you may find that caring responsibilities eat into comfort, or that comfort is taken with a guilty eye on those who need you. Resources feel stretched between giving and enjoying. A deliberate share set aside for your own pleasure is not selfish in this case. It keeps the giving from turning bitter.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_fortune:
Care and good luck go together in this relationship.

The two of you provide for each other easily and seem to be provided for in turn. Ceres and the Part of Fortune agree, so that home is comfortable, food is plentiful and there is a general sense of being well supplied. It is a happy placement. Gratitude suits it, along with some thought for where the surplus might do good.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_fortune:
One of you does the providing and the other enjoys the luck.

Ceres works to sustain and the Part of Fortune simply receives. Opposed, the two can seem unfairly distributed, with one partner labouring over care while ease falls to the other. Resentment is possible. So is a useful exchange, since the fortunate one can lighten the carer's load and the carer can give the luck some purpose.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_spirit:
This relationship chooses to make care its purpose.

The Part of Spirit is deliberate intention, what a pair sets out to do. Ceres joined to it directs that intention toward nurturing. The two of you may decide to raise a family, grow food, or look after people in some organised way, and bring real will to it. It is a purposeful kind of tenderness. Care that is a mission can become relentless, and needs a day off.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_spirit:
Care can be given a clear direction in this relationship.

The Part of Spirit is the pair's conscious aim and Ceres its ability to sustain. With a sextile, the two of you can decide where your looking-after is best spent and follow through. It turns general goodwill into something definite. The step from wishing to deciding is yours to take.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_spirit:
What this relationship intends and whom it must care for are at odds.

The Part of Spirit sets a chosen course. Ceres answers to need as it arises. Squared, plans are interrupted by caring duties, and duties are resented as obstacles. One of you may feel that ambition is being sacrificed, or that it is being put ahead of people. The conflict returns until the plan is redrawn to include those who depend on you.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_spirit:
Purpose and care support each other here.

The two of you find that what you mean to accomplish and what you naturally look after are much the same. Ceres gives the pair's intentions a human warmth, and the Part of Spirit gives its caring a sense of direction. Work done together has heart. There is little to warn against, beyond taking on more than two people can sustain.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_spirit:
One of you follows the plan and the other minds the people.

The Part of Spirit pushes ahead with intention and Ceres stays with those who need tending. Across the relationship, one partner becomes the driver of projects and the other the keeper of the household. Each thinks their own task the essential one. They depend on each other entirely. Acknowledging that, aloud, takes much of the strain out of the division.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_pholus:
In this relationship a small act of care can change a great deal.

Pholus is the small cause with large effects. Ceres is nurture. Together they make the two of you unusually sensitive to what is taken in: food, drink, medicine, kindness. A modest change in how you look after each other can transform the whole atmosphere. It works in both directions, and a small neglect can have large results as well. Old family matters about care may suddenly come to light.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_pholus:
A small change in care can open up something larger here.

Ceres tends and Pholus releases. With a sextile, the two of you can use a simple gesture, a shared meal, a question asked kindly, to begin a conversation that has been waiting a long time. The effect is out of proportion to the effort. It is worth trying when something feels stuck.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_pholus:
Matters of care are apt to blow up unexpectedly.

Ceres wants things kept steady and Pholus takes the lid off. Squared, a small dispute about food, health or family can set off a much larger release of feeling than anyone expected. Old grief or resentment about being looked after, or not, comes pouring out. Substances can play a part. Going slowly, and not opening everything at once, keeps the consequences manageable.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_pholus:
This relationship lets go of old burdens about care with relative ease.

Ceres and Pholus cooperate. The two of you can release long-held family patterns around food, dependence and loss without great upheaval, often through some ordinary event that proves to be a turning point. Change in the household comes naturally. The process is kind. It only asks that you notice when it is happening and allow it.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_pholus:
One of you keeps things steady and the other sets things off.

Ceres maintains and Pholus uncorks. Opposed, one partner becomes the guardian of routine and the other the one whose small action brings on a flood. The guardian feels the work undone and the other is astonished at the result. What comes out was already there. Dealing with it together is better than blaming whoever happened to open it.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_south_node:
Nurturing is the pattern this relationship falls into without thinking.

The South Node is what comes automatically, and Ceres there makes it caretaking. The two of you slip into feeding, tending and worrying over each other as if you had always done it. It is comfortable and competent. It can also be a retreat, with the familiar business of looking after used to avoid the less familiar growth that lies at the other end of the axis.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_south_node:
The pair has an old fund of caring skill to draw on.

Ceres links easily to the South Node's store of past experience. The two of you know how to look after people, and can call on that when it is needed without having to learn it. Because the sextile also reaches toward the North Node, this skill can serve the relationship's growth. Used that way it is an asset, and no kind of anchor.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_south_node:
Caring duties cut across both the old pattern and the new aim.

Ceres squares the nodal axis from this side as from the other. The work of tending fits neither where the two of you have been nor where you are going, and so it can feel like a constant interruption. Each of you may handle it differently. The care is still owed. Finding a place for it in the plan is part of what the relationship has to work out.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_south_node:
Looking after each other is second nature here.

Ceres and the South Node agree, so nurture flows from habit. The two of you settle into mutual care quickly and it feels like something remembered. The comfort is real and worth having. Since it costs nothing, it can stand in for effort elsewhere, and the pair may need to push itself toward whatever is less practised.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_south_node:
Learning to nurture is the direction this relationship is growing in.

Opposite the South Node, Ceres stands with the North Node. The habits the two of you bring are likely to be independent or detached ones. What is being asked for is patience, tending, and willingness to be needed. It may feel unfamiliar and even burdensome at first. Each time it is chosen, the relationship becomes more of what it is meant to be.
composite_aspect.ceres_conjunction_vesta:
Care in this relationship is given with complete dedication.

Vesta is the tended flame, focused and devoted. Ceres is the provider. Joined, they make looking after the home, the family or a chosen charge into something close to a vocation. The two of you take it seriously and do it thoroughly. Others can rely on you absolutely. The devotion can crowd out lightness, and the carers themselves may go untended.
composite_aspect.ceres_sextile_vesta:
Focus can make this relationship's caring count for more.

Ceres gives care and Vesta gives concentration. The sextile lets the two of you put your whole attention on one thing that needs tending and do it properly. A sick relative, a new child, a demanding season at home all benefit. It is a matter of choosing where to direct the effort, and then keeping to it.
composite_aspect.ceres_square_vesta:
Devotion to a task and care for people compete for the same hours.

Vesta asks for single-minded focus. Ceres asks who needs feeding. Squared, one of you may withdraw into work or practice while the other is left holding the household, or care for others may leave no time for what each of you holds sacred. Both feel neglected in turn. It is eased by protecting a small fixed time for each claim.
composite_aspect.ceres_trine_vesta:
Dedication and nurture are well matched here.

The two of you look after what matters with steady, wholehearted attention. Ceres supplies the warmth and Vesta the constancy. The home has the feel of a place that is kept on purpose. Work done for others is done well and without complaint. It only remains to see that the keepers of the flame are warmed by it too.
composite_aspect.ceres_opposition_vesta:
One of you tends the people and the other tends the flame.

Ceres gives outwardly and Vesta keeps to her own centre. Opposed, one partner becomes the one who looks after everybody, and the other the one who is absorbed in work, study or devotion. The carer feels alone with the load and the devoted one feels constantly interrupted. Each guards something valuable. A fair exchange of time lets both be kept.
